papers.title: ScaFE: Data-Efficient Scar Classification with LLM-Generated Clinical Feature Programs
papers.authors: Ruman Wang, Hangting Ye
papers.affiliations: Liaoning University of Traditional Chinese Medicine; School of Artificial Intelligence, Jilin University
papers.intro: 论文提出 ScaFE（Scar Feature Engineering），利用大语言模型（LLM）从临床指南和文献中检索证据，生成可执行的图像特征提取程序，在本地提取结构化特征后用轻量级随机森林分类器进行疤痕类型判别，实现了无需将患者图像发送给模型的高效、可审计的医学图像分类。

papers.title: MarkushGlyph and OCSRGlyph: Improved Chemical Structure Recognition
papers.authors: Alex Andonian, Samuel G Rodriques, Andrew D White, Siddharth M Narayanan
papers.intro: 本文提出OCSRGlyph和MarkushGlyph两个模型，将单分子和Markush结构识别统一为图像到文本的生成问题，分别达到OCSR和Markush识别的最新最先进水平，并引入更严格的Markush翻译评估指标。

papers.title: RefCaptioner: Multi-Reference Image-Grounded Video Captioning
papers.authors: Tengfei Liu, Yang Shi, Yuran Wang, Xiaohan Zhang, Yuqing Wen, Yuqi Tang, Qixun Wang, Zhuoran Zhang, Xuanyu Zhu, Weihong Lin, Xinlei Yu, Yujie Wei, Xinwei Long, Fengxiang Wang, Xinlong Chen, Yue Ding, Jialu Chen, Haotian Wang, Yuanxing Zhang
papers.affiliations: 北京大学（PKU）、Kling Team、新加坡国立大学（NUS）、南京大学（NJU）、香港科技大学（广州）（HKUST(GZ)）、香港中文大学（CUHK）、复旦大学（FDU）、清华大学（THU）、上海人工智能实验室、中国科学院自动化研究所（CASIA）
papers.intro: 论文提出 RefCaptioner，一种两阶段后训练框架，通过混合数据 SFT 和层级覆盖折扣 GRPO（HCD-GRPO），让视频字幕模型在保持通用描述能力的同时，将多张参考图片以短语级标签的形式准确、一致地绑定到视频中的对应视觉事实。

papers.title: AuricularWorld: Hierarchical Action-Guided World Modeling for Fine-Grained Auricular Structure Segmentation from CT Scans
papers.authors: Jingwen Yang, Senmao Wang, Luoyao Kang, Runmeng Cui, Keying Zhang, Yunjia Bao, Haifan Gong, Lin Lin, Haiyue Jiang
papers.affiliations: Plastic Surgery Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College; The Chinese University of Hong Kong; The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen)
papers.intro: 提出一种基于世界模型的耳廓CT分割框架AuricularWorld，通过在编码器-解码器中间潜空间中引入确定性循环状态空间模型，以分层解剖动作引导潜变量滚动演化，实现对细小、不规则、重叠耳廓结构的精细分割。

papers.title: Towards Autonomous Aircraft Surveillance from Nanosatellites through On-Board Inference and Generative Data Augmentation
papers.authors: Antonio Delgado-Rosa, David Muñoz-Valero, Enrique Adrian Villarrubia-Martin, Juan Moreno-Garcia
papers.affiliations: Universidad de Castilla–La Mancha（西班牙卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰大学）
papers.intro: 该论文提出一种将星上推理（6U CubeSat + Coral Edge TPU）与基于FLUX+LoRA的生成式数据增强相结合的完整工作流，通过合成少数类图像平衡数据集，并用INT8量化检测器实现在轨实时飞机监视，将mAP从77.9%提升至82.2%，少数类F1从0.683提升至0.811。

papers.title: Can Vision-Language Models Reason about AI Edits in Images?
papers.authors: Darsha Udayanga, Pin-Yu Chen, Payel Das, Qiang Ji
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于GRPO强化学习的训练框架，让视觉语言模型无需显式推理标注，仅通过简单的格式奖励和准确率奖励就能在判断图像是否被AI编辑前生成推理轨迹，并借助轻量分割模型将推理结果和边界框转换为像素级篡改掩码，以弱监督方式达到与强监督SOTA方法可比的检测与定位性能。

papers.title: VisualRouter: Query-Grounded Visual Sampling for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Haiyue Zhang, Yi Bin, Xun Jiang, Zeyu Ma, Duo Peng, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Heng Tao Shen
papers.affiliations: Tongji University（同济大学）；University of Electronic Science and Technology of China（电子科技大学）
papers.intro: VisualRouter提出了一种无需训练、即插即用的查询引导视觉采样框架，通过将查询划分为全局或局部两种类型，分别采用“相关性-覆盖度混合”与“事件感知”两种采样策略，从而在有限帧预算下同时兼顾相关性、覆盖度和多样性，显著提升多个LVLM在长视频理解任务上的表现。

papers.title: ViewMind3D: Modular View-Aware Inference for Training-Free 3D-QA
papers.authors: Ping-Kun Chiang, Kun-Ru Wu, Po-han Li, Sandeep Chinchali, Ufuk Topcu, Yu-Chee Tseng
papers.intro: ViewMind3D提出了一种完全无需训练的模块化3D问答框架，通过多视图相关性选择、引导式目标检测、BEV视角指示和结构化多阶段推理，仅利用通用LLM/VLM即可在ScanQA和SQA3D上取得与微调方法相当的竞争性能。

papers.title: Why Are GUI Agents Correct but Late? Decode on the Decision-Time Critical Path, Tested with Pre-Compiled Policy Trees
papers.authors: Zihan Dong, Rui Qian, Qishi Zhan, Dongshen Peng, Kaixin Li, Yu Li
papers.affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology; Fudan University; Marquette University; University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; National University of Singapore; Southeast University
papers.intro: 本文提出自适应预期策略树（AAPT），通过让冻结的多模态模型在空闲时预编译带守卫和截止时间的条件策略树，并在事件发生时用轻量级观察者仅做低延迟路由来触发预授权动作，从而将解码过程移出决策关键路径，显著提升瞬态窗口内的任务成功率。

papers.title: Hand-Object Interaction in the Age of Large Foundation Models:Reconstruction, Generation, and Embodied Transfer
papers.authors: Weiquan Lin, Yu Deng, Shiyang Liu, Luping Xiao, Xu Tang, Junzhi Yu, Jiaolong Yang, Lei Zhang, Xingyu Chen
papers.affiliations: Xidian University; Zhongguancun Academy; Microsoft Research Asia; Peking University; Visincept
papers.intro: 该综述首次构建了面向手-物交互重建与生成的基础模型先验系统分类体系，将文献组织为六大任务与八类子先验，揭示了先验注入机制及其向机器人学习迁移的路径。

papers.title: How Benchmarks Mis-Score Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Zihan Dong, Zhiyuan Ma, Zekun Wang, Yunqing Li, Zirou Liu, Ruixuan Deng, Qishi Zhan, Rui Qian
papers.affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology; North Carolina State University; Lenovo AI Technology Center; University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; Marquette University; Fudan University
papers.intro: 本文提出一个覆盖任务构造、轨迹观测、评分和报告的四阶段CUA评估可靠性框架，并通过审计150条公开失败轨迹发现15.3%的FAIL判定是错误（10.7%为评估器假阴性，4.7%为任务损坏），同时用三层诊断分类法揭示真实失败中验证/反馈和规划错误占主导。

papers.title: MonoVoc: Decoupling Geometry and Semantics for Lightweight Monocular Open-Vocabulary 3D Gaussians
papers.authors: Pouya Ardekhani, Zahra Dehghanian, Morteza Abolghasemi, Hamid R. Rabiee
papers.affiliations: Sharif University of Technology, Tehran, Iran
papers.intro: MonoVoc提出一种无需训练的单目开放词汇3D高斯语义地图构建流程，通过显式解耦几何重建与语义集成，在保持渲染保真度和分割精度的同时，将内存占用相比SOTA基线降低一个数量级。

papers.title: Beyond Visual Ambiguity: Guiding Robust Monocular Depth Estimation in Challenging Scenarios via Detailed Long Captions
papers.authors: Junrui Zhang, Jiaqi Li, Yiran Wang, Liao Shen, Zhiguo Cao
papers.tags: depth estimation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: 华中科技大学人工智能与自动化学院（School of Artificial Intelligence and Automation, Huazhong University of Science and Technology）
papers.intro: 本文提出CapDepth框架，利用详细长描述（Detailed Long Captions）作为语言指导，通过动态描述编码器和文本自适应解码器，同时缓解非朗伯表面和恶劣天气下的视觉歧义，显著提升单目深度估计的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
papers.authors: Hanzhang Zhou, Panrong Tong, Xu Zhang, Quyu Kong, Chenglin Cai, Tianyu Xia, Gongjie Zhang, Jianan Zhang, Long Li, Long Chen, Lei Wang, Gaole Dai, Pengxiang Li, Liangyu Chen, Yue Wang, Steven Hoi
papers.intro: 本文提出Qwen-UI-Agent，一个以真实世界为中心的通用GUI基础代理，通过大规模真实设备移动环境、混合GUI+CLI动作空间、自动化数据飞轮和在线强化学习，在移动、桌面、网页和DeepSearch任务上取得了领先或极具竞争力的性能。

papers.title: Echoverse: Deep, Evolving Environments for Training Computer-Use Agents at Scale
papers.authors: Yash Pandya, Sahil Gupta, Sarthak Harne, Archana Yadav, Kavyansh Chourasia, Hussein Mozannar, Vibhav Vineet, Sara Abdali, Corby Rosset, Yash Lara, Ahmed Awadallah, Ece Kamar, Akshay Nambi
papers.affiliations: Microsoft Research（其中 Sahil Gupta 和 Archana Yadav 标注为在 Microsoft Research 工作期间完成，通讯作者 Akshay Nambi 邮箱 akshayn@microsoft.com）
papers.intro: Echoverse 提出一种将环境构建与模型训练统一为共同进化过程的路线：通过从目标工作流反向构建“深”的环境，并利用每次评分的轨迹同时修复环境、任务、验证器和训练模型，使一个9B模型在14个评测分割上从36.5%提升到67.1%，接近教导它的更大规模前沿模型。

papers.title: VidMap: Exploiting Temporal Structure for Video-Based Structure-from-Motion
papers.authors: Zador Pataki, Paul-Edouard Sarlin, Marc Pollefeys
papers.affiliations: ETH Zurich, Google, Microsoft Spatial AI Lab
papers.intro: VidMap结合SLAM的时序约束和SfM的全局优化，通过密集匹配、时间感知的闭环检测和度量深度先验，实现对任意未标定长视频的度量和鲁棒重建。

papers.title: HumanCLAW: Can Vision-Language Models Act Through a Body?
papers.authors: Siyao Li, Jiawei Gu, Shuai Liu, Kairui Hu, Zekun Li, Linjie Li, Chengcheng Tang, Po-Chen Wu, Ivan Shugurov, Lingni Ma, Michael Zollhoefer, Sizhe An, Abhay Mittal, Amy Zhao, Ranjay Krishna, Manling Li, Ziwei Liu, Chuan Guo
papers.affiliations: Meta, Nanyang Technological University, University of Washington, Brown University, Northwestern University
papers.intro: HumanCLAW 是一种将 VLM 的决策与运动执行解耦的评估框架，通过原子技能调用和半物理模拟器构建闭环全身动作循环，揭示当前前沿 VLM 在长时域导航-交互任务中因缺乏“具身自我意识”（embodied self-awareness）而成功率极低（最佳仅16.8%）。

papers.title: Explainable and Resource-Efficient Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs for Decision-Critical Applications
papers.authors: Piyush Jain, Kousik Dasgupta, Rajarshi Roy, Subarna Tripathi
papers.affiliations: Heritage Institute of Technology (Piyush Jain), Kalyani Government Engineering College (Kousik Dasgupta), IAIRO (Rajarshi Roy), Intel Corporation (Subarna Tripathi)
papers.intro: ByDeWay-V2 是一个无需训练、模块化的框架，通过将显式空间关系谓词与深度线索结合到提示中，增强了MLLM在资源受限场景下的空间推理能力和可解释性，并在VSR和BLINK基准上显著提升了F1分数。

papers.title: SeasonStereo: Robust Dense Stereo Matching for Multi-Date Satellite Imagery via Generative AI
papers.authors: Álvaro Díaz-Laureano, Roger Marí, Elías Masquil, Pablo Arias, Gabriele Facciolo
papers.affiliations: Eurecat, Multimedia Technologies, Barcelona, Spain; IIE, Facultad de Ingeniería, Universidad de la República, Uruguay; Dept. of Engineering, Universitat Pompeu Fabra, Barcelona, Spain; Université Paris-Saclay, CNRS, ENS Paris-Saclay, Centre Borelli, France; Institut Universitaire de France
papers.intro: SeasonStereo 通过生成式AI合成带有可控季节性变化的立体影像对，并结合基础模型的零样本几何先验作为监督，训练出鲁棒的密集立体匹配模型，实现了不依赖LiDAR标签的多日期卫星影像视差估计，且精度与最优LiDAR监督模型相当。

papers.title: Towards Grounded GI Endoscopy VQA via Multi-Task Learning on Small VLMs
papers.authors: Itbaan Safwan, Ramail Khan, Muhammad Annas Shaikh, Muhammad Atif Tahir
papers.tags: visual question answering, multimodal learning, medical image
papers.affiliations: Institute of Business and Administration, Karachi, Pakistan
papers.intro: 本文提出一种多任务微调方法，在小型VLM上联合VQA、弱监督接地分割和术语无关的视觉描述任务，不仅提升了VQA准确率，还改善了模型内部答案token与图像相关区域的隐式对齐能力。
